bullets.content: [general] Meshing is deterministic: identical recipes tie with zero bonus (a2/a12 both applied the playbook's flank zmin 0.020 -> same 6765 nodes). Never use a suggested change verbatim. After mesh(), reject node counts within 1% of known meshes: 5760, 6081, 6211, 6697, 6765, 6932, 7073, 7075, 7152, 7642, 5497, 5638, 5997, 6122, 6205, 6389, 6560, 6622, 6684, 6972.

[general] Use all 4 solves as distinct single-factor tests (a15, a1 used only 2; a1 wasted one on an h-only step). Plan: frame, structural variant, one-factor size test, best combination. Never go coarser than solve 1; compare two different solve numbers, never compare(x,x).

[general] solve() uses the LAST mesh() call (stale/invalid meshes wasted solves for a6, a7, a10, a13). Re-call the intended mesh() right before solve(), check solve 'nodes' equals the intended count. Price 3-5 meshes free, pick fewest nodes with min_quality>=0.1. Ties/resubmits (a9=a13 5570, a4 5705) pay nothing.

[general] After solve 1 call view(kind=error) and read the 5 hotspots with nearest face/edge and local h. If a hotspot with >=7% share has local h >1.3x requested, switch to a box centred on it (±3 mm); name those targets next.

[general] Read min_quality on every mesh call; keep >=0.13 for margin (>=0.1 required). Near-limit: h 0.0065 (0.114), edge 40 0.0022 (0.1198), no body box with edges 0.002 (0.1099). Use radius >=0.004 on edges and boxes at h 0.01-0.012.
[general] compare() between different meshes carries 0.12-0.17 remeshing noise; not convergence or gain evidence alone. Combine with strain energy change and hotspot local h.
[general] Wasted solves: order 1 (locking), h sweeps moving nodes <8%, re-solving an old recipe. Plan distinct single-factor meshes.

[general] Pick submission by estimated score, not safety: e^2*DOFs (below target) or e*DOFs (above), e~N^-0.43. Name the binding term first: when point RMS is within ~1% of field, a field gain buys nothing; rank by max(field, points)×DOFs.
[general] Field energy error usually exceeds check-point RMS, so target error energy (hotspots, error view) first, unless points bind (check).

[general] Strain energy ranked true field error again (0.033593 J->17.4% ... 0.033130->19.1%). ~0.1% energy ~ 1% field error. Pays if energy gain % >= 0.05x DOF increase %. Differences <0.05-0.3% are noise: submit the cheaper mesh.
[general] Calibrate: one fine reference solve (~sizes x0.75); true field error ~1.2-1.35x compare(candidate, reference). Rank by e*DOFs (above target).
[general] Any local size must be <=0.6x surrounding h or it does nothing. Check hotspot local h and 'element size near each group'.

[general] Box radius is ignored by this mesher on abc_00000065 (identical node counts for r0.003-0.012); test by pricing two radii with mesh() before spending a solve. Keep radius <=0.008 on ~35-mm bodies.

[general] Ties pay nothing: spend one solve on a structurally different recipe (order, h >1.5x, different target set) costing <10% base, keep base >=90% of best. Never resubmit a peer's or last generation's exact recipe; swapping one box earns nothing.
[general] Diversity needs MOSTLY different targets, another order or h>1.5x off. Each generation at least one agent runs a frame no peer uses, base >=90% of best.
[general] Above 2x target, uniform scaling only breaks even. Only moving DOFs from low-error regions to missed hotspots raises base.
[general] Hard regions: low-stress far field/shafts sized only by global h (point bonus plays), box seams and size jumps, uncovered lobes outside boxes, singular clamp edges. Cover each deliberately.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Base flat: e^2N 626-667, base 0.231-0.246 at 17.3-21.5k DOFs, field 17.4-19.1%. Rank decided by diversity (+0.1, needs base >=0.221) and point bonuses. Use a unique target set; verify energy >=0.0334 J at ~20k DOFs. Pay line: energy gain % >=0.05-0.075x DOF %.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] a5 cheapest: 17.3k DOFs base 0.245 at h 0.03; flank ladder 0.003 6510 nodes/0.033234 J; 0.0035 5760/0.033130; 0.004 5338/0.032718 (knee 0.0035). Needs shaft boxes. a1 h 0.0065 gave best points 7.8% but e^2N 667, quality 0.114. h 0.0075, 0.0065, 0.012, 0.014, 0.03 taken.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Body box sweet spot 0.0048-0.0054 (r0.008). 0.0058 reads ~11% low at lower-wall cell 48 (z 0.005); 0.0066 lost 1.67%; 0.0037 +45% DOFs for 1.7%. Keep z 0-0.02 at <=0.0054; never start/stop boxes in z 0.003-0.02. Never replace body box by f23 + edges (0.03091 J, ~-7.5%).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Body-box ladder (a5): 0.0055/0.0048/0.0037 gave 16.9k/19.8k/28.8k DOFs, 0.03292/0.03340/0.03396 J; 0.0055->0.0048 pays marginally, ->0.0037 does not. Disclosed-point refinements cost DOFs; drop.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Rim boxes [0.015,-0.01,0.025,0.024,0.01,0.035]+mirror 0.003 pay only on top of saddle/flank boxes (a5 +1.0% energy for +8.3% DOFs); as sole junction refinement worst (20.2%).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Boss-root junction holds 30-36% of error energy. Edges 39/8 at 0.0024 outside boxes with flanks 0.0036 gave best e^2N; inside a junction box <=0.0038 they are redundant (+6% DOFs, -0.04%). Use edges OR fine box, not both. Flank zmin 0.019-0.020 avoids low cell 97.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction zone: a15 [-0.024,-0.018,0.018,0.024,0.018,0.038] 0.004 r0.006 with flanks 0.003, f2 0.0025: 0.033593 J, field 17.4%, point bonus; 0.0045->0.004 +4.2% nodes +0.43% energy pays. a10 single box 0.0038, h 0.01 no flanks. Top zone required (-2% dropped) but saturated at 0.0052-0.0058. Overlap >=2 mm.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Keep ONE body box z 0-0.0575 at <=0.0054 covering lower wall. Never refine whole f20/f23. Lower-wall cells 24/42/43/48 vary both ways (remeshing noise); only point-bonus test: box [-0.024,-0.017,0,-0.012,0.017,0.012] 0.0042 as single factor.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring (14-17% of error) saturated: f2 0.0025 + edge 40 0.0025 gives 14.2-14.4% (edge 40 +0.4% energy for +4.4% DOFs passed); f2 0.003 alone 18.0%; edge 40 0.0022 lower energy, quality 0.1198. Never clamp volume box instead of f2.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Score flat in DOFs (error ~N^-0.43). Aim 15-21k DOFs; h 0.03 only with shaft boxes. Do not resubmit a3/a15 unchanged.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Shafts/outer bosses (|x|>0.021: f3, f15, f16, f17) hold little energy but are the most contested (spread 9.3% near f16; h 0.012 reads 11-13% low, h 0.03 +29%). Add mirrored shaft boxes [0.021,-0.012,0.018,0.034,0.012,0.042]+mirror at 0.0045 r0.004; check f16/f3 touching h <=0.0045.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Diversity axes: (a) zoned body lower 0.0054, junction 0.0038, top 0.0054, f2+edge 40; (b) box-only frame h 0.014 with junction boxes 0.0033; (c) a15/a10 zoned plus shaft boxes or quadrants; (d) a0 frame with flank |y| 0.016. Zoned and flank frames already lost diversity: change target set.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup correct in all runs: 3d, fixed f2; 4e6 Pa on f23; 2.1e6 Pa on f16; E=2.1e11, nu=0.3, order 2 (order 1 locks). Reuse verbatim.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Above target base=1063/(e*DOFs). Plateau e*DOFs 1351-1414 at 15.5-17k DOFs. Field error ≈1.16-1.2x compare(candidate, x0.75 ref). Energy ranks field but neither sees points. Submit cheaper of two candidates within 3%.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Point RMS noisy (6.1-11.4%) and can bind: a0 h 0.0075 field 7.75% but points 11.4%. Keep h 0.008 (or 0.007 if quality forces). Without the band points bind at 8.1-9.7%.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Keep wide band [0.014,-0.026,-0.0081,0.028,0.024,-0.0035] 0.003: ~20 nodes, points 6.1-6.3% vs 8.1-9.7% without. Never drop. Add +y lobe box [0.015,0.014,-0.0081,0.025,0.024,-0.002] 0.0034 (+169 nodes, a11 field 7.94%) only on a frame with the band.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Clamp layer z -0.0081..-0.006 (x 0.018-0.027) holds 30-40% of error but is saturated (h 0.0025, 4-5% VM error). Keep tier1 0.0018 or single box 0.0016; thicker zmax -0.0063 lowered energy. Never coarsen to 0.0026. Stop tuning it.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] With band present tier2 is redundant (a7: -115 nodes, -0.01% energy, quality 0.114, 5159 nodes, 15477 DOFs, points 6.08%). Without band tier2 needed for quality. Untested: a7 no-tier2 plus a14 ymax 0.015.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Upper box load-bearing: dropping it -0.78% energy for -7% nodes. Ladder 0.0048/0.0042/0.0038: knee 0.0042-0.0043. Quality: upper 0.0045 at h 0.008 gave 0.0962 invalid. Seam z≈-0.003 reads 3-7% low: test upper zmin -0.0045 at 0.0043 single factor.
